甜、酸、咸、苦、鲜是五种公认的基本味觉。不同味觉细胞分布在许多有味蕾的区域，舌尖: Sweet, sour, salty, bitter and umami are five established basic tastes. Different taste cells occur across many taste-bud-bearing regions. The tip is not exclusively sweet, nor the back exclusively bitter.
食盐中的离子带来咸味。: Ions in table salt produce saltiness.
许多不同物质能带来苦味。: Many different substances can taste bitter.
谷氨酸等参与鲜味。: Glutamate and other compounds contribute to umami.
味蕾不是小舌头: A taste bud is not a tiny tongue

吃东西时，一些气味分子从口腔后方到鼻腔。这叫后鼻嗅觉，和从鼻孔闻花香的入口不同。: While eating, some aroma molecules reach the nose from the back of the mouth. This is retronasal smell, a different entry from sniffing a flower through your nostrils.
辣不是第六种基本味觉: Chili heat is not a sixth basic taste

深入看：细胞受体与多感觉整合: A closer look: cellular receptors and multisensory integration
味觉细胞顶端的微绒毛接近味孔，能接触唾液中的物质。不同味质采用不同的受体或离子通: Microvilli at the tops of taste cells approach the taste pore and contact substances in saliva. Different taste qualities involve different receptors or ion channels. Cellular responses are communicated through nerves and processed further in the brain. Green highlights indicate signaling; they do not imply that every taste cell has the same receptor.
嗅觉感受细胞位于鼻腔上部。后鼻嗅觉需要挥发性分子到达那里，再转成神经信号；不是香: Smell-sensing cells lie in the upper nasal cavity. Retronasal smell requires volatile molecules to reach that region and generate nerve signals; aroma does not enter the brain directly. Complex airflow, nerve relays and brain networks are omitted. Slow-motion stages do not give exact sensory timing. Smell, basic tastes, texture and temperature have no fixed contribution percentages.
这是原生 SVG 的概念切面，不是解剖照片。味蕾数量、细胞类型、形状、颜色、尺度: These original SVG conceptual sections are not anatomical photographs. Taste-bud numbers, cell types, shapes, colors, scales and timing are simplified. No tongue taste map is drawn, and taste is not used to judge food safety.
紫色虚线是香气经过空气的路；实线是神经消息的路。: The purple dashed line is aroma traveling through air; solid lines carry neural messages.

这是图上并排比较，不模拟堵鼻后的个人体验或嗅觉贡献百分比。: This side-by-side comparison does not simulate an individual's experience of nasal blockage or assign a percentage to smell.
食物中的可溶小分子进入唾液，靠近 A 点的味蕾。: Small soluble molecules from food enter saliva and approach taste bud A.
味质分子溶于唾液后，接触味蕾顶端味孔附近的味觉细胞。另有挥发性分子可走向后鼻通道: After dissolving in saliva, tastant molecules contact taste cells near the pore at the top of a taste bud. Other volatile molecules can enter the retronasal passage.
小点、数量和速度均为示意；它们不代表一种食物的真实浓度。: Dots, counts and speeds are illustrative; they do not represent the actual concentration in a food.
味蕾里的细胞接到化学线索，开始把消息传给神经。: Cells in the taste bud detect chemical clues and begin communicating with nerves.
不同味质涉及不同受体或离子通道机制。味觉细胞的反应经与神经纤维的联系继续传递。: Different taste qualities involve distinct receptor or ion-channel mechanisms. Responses of taste cells are relayed through their connections with nerve fibers.
放大的细胞种类、数量和形状经过简化，也没有画出全部突触。: The enlarged cell types, counts and shapes are simplified, and not all synapses are drawn.
绿色线从舌头走；紫色香气先经空气到鼻腔上部。: The green route starts at the tongue; purple aroma first travels through air to the upper nose.
味觉传入神经与嗅觉感受神经不是同一路；后鼻气味先到嗅觉上皮，随后才以神经活动传递: Taste afferents and olfactory sensory neurons follow different routes. Retronasal odorants first reach the olfactory epithelium, then are encoded as neural activity.
两条路径并排慢放，不能从图中读取真实气流、传导速度或感觉先后。: The two paths are slowed side by side; the diagram does not show real airflow, conduction speeds or sensory timing.
脑结合味觉、香气和口感，才有熟悉的食物风味。: The brain combines taste, aroma and texture into familiar food flavor.
脑对味觉、嗅觉和三叉神经、温度、质地等信息进行整合；图中只强调两条化学感觉路径。: The brain integrates taste, smell, trigeminal, temperature and texture information; the diagram emphasizes only two chemical-sense routes.
开关只比较画出的线索，没有测量个人风味、偏好或嗅觉百分比。: The switch compares drawn cues only; it does not measure a person's flavor experience, preferences or a smell percentage.
挥发性分子经后鼻通道到嗅觉上皮，额外增加嗅觉信息；味觉传入仍走原来的通路。: Volatile molecules reach the olfactory epithelium by the retronasal passage, adding smell information while taste afferents keep their route.
只在图上移去后鼻嗅觉线索；味觉细胞与传入通路仍保留，不能据此推断个人体验完全无味: Only the retronasal smell cue is removed from the diagram. Taste cells and afferents remain, so an individual's flavor experience cannot be inferred as completely absent.
香气从嘴巴后方到鼻子，和舌头的消息一起参与风味。: Aroma moves from behind the mouth to the nose and joins messages from the tongue in flavor.
拿掉紫色香气线，绿色味觉线仍在。食物不会突然完全没味道。: Remove the purple aroma route and the green taste route remains. The food does not suddenly become completely tasteless.
